first_product_repair_packet.independent_replay_script:
import hashlib,json,sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
import libsbml,roadrunner,numpy as np
from scripts.ci import validate_sbml_test_suite as runner
from bionetgen.atomizer.modern.parser import SBMLParser
out=Path('/private/tmp/bng3-01133-reduction')
source=Path('/private/tmp/bng3-ssts-20261016/cases/semantic/01133/01133-sbml-l3v2.xml')
reference=runner._read_reference_case({'category':'semantic','id':'01133','path':source})
rr=roadrunner.RoadRunner(str(source))
rr.integrator.relative_tolerance=1e-9
rr.integrator.absolute_tolerance=1e-14
selections=['time',*[f'[{v}]' for v in reference['variables']]]
data=np.asarray(rr.simulate(times=reference['times'].tolist(),selections=selections))
comparison=runner._compare_reference_series(reference['expected'],{v:data[:,i+1] for i,v in enumerate(reference['variables'])},absolute=reference['absolute'],relative=reference['relative'],sample_times=reference['times'])
minimal='''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version2/core" level="3" version="2">
  <model id="dimension7">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="C" spatialDimensions="7" size="1" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies><species id="S" compartment="C" initialConcentration="2.5" hasOnlySubstanceUnits="false" boundaryCondition="true" constant="true"/></listOfSpecies>
  </model>
</sbml>
'''
(out/'dimension7.xml').write_text(minimal)
parsed=SBMLParser().parse(minimal)
control=roadrunner.RoadRunner(minimal)
control.integrator.relative_tolerance=1e-9
control.integrator.absolute_tolerance=1e-14
values=np.asarray(control.simulate(0,1,11,selections=['time','[S]']))
report={
 'purpose':'diagnostic source/translation reduction only; no exact-candidate native qualification',
 'python':sys.version,'libsbml_version':libsbml.getLibSBMLDottedVersion(),'roadrunner_version':roadrunner.__version__,'numpy_version':np.__version__,
 'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'settings_sha256':reference['settings_sha256'],'results_sha256':reference['results_sha256'],
 'source_validation':runner._validate_xml(source.read_text(),'source'),
 'source_reference':{'start':reference['start'],'duration':reference['duration'],'steps':reference['steps'],'absolute':reference['absolute'],'relative':reference['relative'],'amount':reference['amount'],'concentration':reference['concentration']},
 'independent_solver':{'engine':'libRoadRunner CVODE','rtol':1e-9,'atol':1e-14,'selections':selections},
 'independent_official_comparison':comparison,
 'minimal_source':minimal,'minimal_sha256':hashlib.sha256(minimal.encode()).hexdigest(),
 'minimal_validation':runner._validate_xml(minimal,'minimal'),
 'minimal_translation_warnings':[asdict(w) for w in parsed.import_warnings],
 'minimal_independent_values':values.tolist(),
 'minimal_analytic_law':'[S](t)=2.5 for 0<=t<=1; static boundary species, no reactions',
 'minimal_analytic_max_abs_error':float(np.max(np.abs(values[:,1]-2.5))),
}
(out/'independent.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
